en.headline: Deloitte raises Hong Kong full-year IPO forecast to at least HK$480 billion
en.dek: The firm expects about 160 listings and says the total could surpass the 2010 record of roughly HK$450 billion after a strong first three quarters.
body: Deloitte has raised its full-year forecast for Hong Kong IPO fundraising to at least HK$480 billion, saying the city is on track to set a new record that would exceed the roughly HK$450 billion raised in 2010.

The firm said 116 companies listed in the first three quarters of 2026, raising a combined HK$387.9 billion. That represented year-on-year growth of 76 percent in the number of deals and 112 percent in proceeds. About 38 of the listings were A-to-H dual listings, accounting for nearly 70 percent of the total amount raised.

Deloitte now projects around 160 new listings for the full year. Hong Kong ranked second globally in IPO proceeds for the first three quarters, behind Nasdaq, which was boosted by large listings including SpaceX.

zh.headline: 德勤上調全年港股新股融資預測至最少4800億元
zh.dek: 德勤預計全年約有160隻新股上市，融資額有望突破2010年約4500億元的歷史紀錄。
body: 德勤將全年香港新股融資額預測上調至最少4800億元，指有望刷新2010年約4500億元的紀錄。
德勤表示，本港今年首三季有116隻新股上市，融資總額達3879億元，按年分別增長76%及1.12倍。當中38隻為先A後H新股，佔總融資額近七成。
德勤預計全年新股數目約160隻。首三季全球新股融資額方面，香港暫列第二，僅次於受SpaceX等大型新股帶動的美國納斯達克。
